title: LintReport
description: Advisory lint report produced by lintAfterEdit (BEHAV-04). Stored in VERIFICATION block of SUMMARY.md — NOT as a separate file.

linter.description: Tool used. 'none' means no linter detected for this file type. Detection order: JS/CJS: npx eslint → eslint → node --check. Python: ruff check → python3 -m py_compile.

exit_code.description: Exit code from the linter. 0 = clean. Non-zero = findings present. Advisory only — does not block commit.

findings.description: Structured lint findings. Empty array [] for a clean file.

rule.description: Linter rule ID (e.g. 'no-unused-vars', 'E501'). 'syntax' for syntax-only fallback.

fallback_used.description: true if project-local linter not found and a fallback (eslint global / node --check / py_compile) was used.
